'''''Begonia palmata''''' is a species of [[plant]] in the genus ''[[Begonia]]'' of the family [[Begoniaceae]]. It is a small herb of height 20–90 cm tall. It is found in moist places, next to streams  or under the shade. It is found in many parts of Asia, including [[eastern Himalaya]]s.<ref name="Eflora of China">{{cite web|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=242412323|title=Flora of China}}</ref>

==Description==
''Begonia palmata'' is an herb growing 20–90 cm tall.<ref name="Eflora of China"/>

==Distribution==
[[Northeast India]], [[Fujian]], [[Guangdong]] etc. (check the reference for complete list) <ref name="Eflora of China"/> up to elevation of 100–3200 meters<ref name="Eflora of China"/><ref name = "Plant for future">{{cite web|url=https://www.pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Begonia+palmata|title=Plants for a Future}}</ref>
